instruction: Candid action photograph, medium shot. In an outdoor covered concrete pavilion, the man in the blue tank top (R2) is on the left, facing right, throwing a straight punch with his gloved left hand. On the right, the man in the beige t-shirt (R1) stands with his back to the camera, holding up a black focus mitt to catch the punch. The shot captures the dynamic moment of contact between R2's glove and R1's mitt, with a shallow depth of field blurring the background pillars under bright daylight.
